mentions.name: DemoScope
mentions.description: A screen recorder app for iOS and Android that shows the user's face on the screen in real time and supports recording, streaming, live annotation, adding text, drawing, and touch indicators.
mentions.source_excerpt:
A really cool iOS and Android screen recorder.

You can put your face on the screen in real time, record, stream, even annotate live, add text, draw, show touch indicators.
mentions.author: admtal
